en: The Hymn of One Hundred and Eight Names of Ākāśagarbha: Om, homage to the Buddha!
O Ākāśagarbha, benefactor of beings, Great Being of great splendor!
O Great Jewel, O Excellent and Supreme Jewel, O Vajra-Jewel, homage be to you! || 1 ||
O great jewel of consecration, O greatly pure, O greatly auspicious one!
O jewel of the Buddha, O you of purified limbs, O jewel among jewels, homage be to you! (2)
O you who are born from the space of space, O all-encompassing space, O great sky!
O you who are the refuge of the entire realm of space, O foremost of all hopes, homage be to you! 3.
O Ratnasaṃbhava, O one with the jewel-ūrṇā, O Buddha with the ūrṇā, O well-gone Tathāgata!
O you who are the supreme among all jewels, the most excellent in every limb, the embodiment of all that is precious—homage be to you!
O Jewel, foremost of jewels, fierce jewel, all-jewel Tathāgata;
O supreme jewel, great space, equal to space, homage be to you! || 5 ||
O you of great splendor through ornaments, O maker of beauty, O most beautiful one;
O you whose every purpose is pure, O you of pure intent, homage be to you, the practice of giving! (6)
O Jewel of the Dharma, supreme purity; O Jewel of the Saṅgha, Tathāgata; Great Consecration for the sake of the world, for the sake of joy—homage be to you! (7)
O giver, supreme giver, foremost of givers, renouncer, supreme renouncer, bestower;
O you who act for the sake of all beings, for the sake of reality, and for the sake of the great purpose—homage be to you!
O King of Thought, of great splendor, you who embody the method of the perfection of generosity;
O Tathāgata, Great Being, homage be to you, the embodiment of all Buddhas! (9)
O Tathāgata, Great Jewel; O Tathāgata, Great Radiance;
O Tathāgata, Great Banner; O Great Laughter, homage be to you! || 10 ||
O Tathāgata, commander of consecration, great consecration, great sovereign!
O Lord of the World, foremost in the three worlds, sun of the world—homage be to you! (11)
O you who possess the most excellent jewels, O jewel-adornment, O bearer of jewels;
O light of jewels, O great light, O jewel-fame—homage be to you! 12.
O heap of jewels, arisen from the supreme jewel; O gem, O diamond-gem, O possessor of virtues;
O mine of jewels, whose limbs are brilliantly radiant; O you who are all-jewels, homage be to you! (13)
O Great-Souled One, O Lord of Jewels, F fulfiller of all hopes! O heap of jewels that grants the attainment of all intentions, homage be to you! (14)
O foremost among non-existent things, all-pervading, the self of all, granter of boons, great boon-granter!
O manifestation of all prosperity, homage be to you, Vajragarbha! 15.
Whoever should hold this auspicious hundred-and-eight names, that sinless person instantly obtains the consecration of all the Buddhas. (16)
The *Śrī-Ākāśagarbha-nāmāṣṭaśatādhyeṣaṇā-stotra* is complete.
